leaveConfirm: Leave this page? Your recording has not been saved and will be lost.

prompt.label: What to record
prompt.spontaneous: Talk about this topic, in your own words:
prompt.conversationalScenario: Have a conversation about this scenario:
prompt.onePhone: Only one phone records, and both speakers are credited for the recording. Put the phone where both of you can be heard clearly.
prompt.rejected: This recording was not accepted earlier. Please record it again.
prompt.rejectedWithReason: This recording was not accepted earlier: {reason}

hint.read: Read the sentence aloud, clearly and at your normal pace. Tap Stop when you finish.
hint.timed: Speak for at least {min} seconds. Find a quiet place and hold the phone at a comfortable distance.
hint.canStop: You can stop whenever you are done.
hint.tooEarly: Keep going: a recording needs at least {min} seconds.

mic.permission-denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
mic.no-mic: No microphone was found. Plug one in or check your device, then try again.
mic.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Open this page in a recent version of Chrome or Safari.
mic.internal: The recording could not start. Close other apps that use the microphone, then try again.

status.failed: The recording could not be sent

problem.title: Let's record it again
problem.too_short: The recording is too short. Please speak for at least {min} seconds.
problem.too_long: The recording is too long. Please keep it under {max} seconds.
problem.too_quiet: The recording is too quiet. Move the phone a little closer to your mouth and speak up.
problem.clipped: The recording is distorted because it is too loud. Move the phone further away and try again.
problem.silence: Leave about a second of silence before you start and after you finish. Wait a moment before you speak and before you tap Stop.

rejected.duration: The team could not accept the length of that recording. Please record it again.
rejected.level: The team could not accept the volume of that recording. Please record it again, a little closer to the microphone.
rejected.silence: The team could not accept the silence at the start or end. Please record it again with a short pause before and after.
rejected.other: The team could not accept that recording. Please record it again.

failed.title: Not sent yet
failed.upload: The audio could not be sent. Your recording is still here.
failed.willUpload: Trying again will send the audio and then save the mission.
failed.alreadyUploaded: Your audio was already sent. Trying again only saves the mission.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Mission {code} is recorded and now waiting for review.
saved.allDone: All done for now. Thank you!

missing.title: Mission not found
missing.body: This mission is not part of your campaign. Go back to the list and pick one.

profile.title: Finish your profile first
profile.body: Complete your profile before you record.

blocked.title: Recording is not available
blocked.body: This campaign is not available for your profile. The team has been told.

consent.title: Consent needed
consent.body: Accept the consent texts before you record.

paused.title: Recording is paused
paused.body: The campaign is paused. Recording reopens when it resumes.

closed.title: Campaign ended
closed.body: This campaign has ended and no longer accepts recordings.

done.title: Already recorded
done.body: This mission has already been recorded. There is nothing more to do here.

partner.title: Waiting for your partner
partner.body: Your conversation partner has not finished their consent yet. You can record this mission once they have.
